title: kuruna wightiana

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to provide relief from coughs and colds, and its potential to aid in digestion, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
